devices.description: List of DVR/IP camera devices to configure and dump from.

devices.items.address.description: IP address or hostname of the DVR/IP camera.

devices.items.port.description: Network port used by the DVR-IP protocol.

devices.items.user.description: Username for authenticating with the DVR.

devices.items.password.description: Password for authenticating with the DVR.

devices.items.channel.description: Channel index (0-255) to dump video from.

devices.items.sub_channel.description: Sub-channel selection: 0 for main, 1 for secondary.

devices.items.operation_mode.description: Operation mode: 0 to display info, 1 to dump video.

devices.items.media_container.description: Media container format: 0 for native DHAV/RAW, 1 for Matroska (MKV).

devices.items.out_file.description: Output file path for video dump. Empty for stdout.

devices.items.keep_alive.description: Keep-alive interval in milliseconds. 0 to disable.

devices.items.timeout.description: Inactivity timeout in milliseconds. 0 to disable.

devices.items.ts_proc.description: Timestamp correction for DHAV stream: 0 to skip, 1 to perform correction.

devices.items.net_protocol_dialect.description: Network protocol dialect: 0 for common, 1 to emulate OEM client.

devices.items.name.description: Human-readable name for the device, used in comments.
